text:
- Use instructed arm for final grasp/place; if none, arm on mat side. If UNREACHABLE, retry with xy on reachable mat area, not handover.
- Locate actual colored mat, not table; if invisible or huge flat object, search with color+shape descriptions and visually confirm.
- Grasp top-down at body centre; place ref=mat relation="on". Add xy=mat centre for small mats/OFF_TARGET, aiming flat/centred.
- Verify images+predicates: mouse visibly on named mat, released, not tilted/elevated (bottom_z near mat top). If RELEASED_NOT_SEEN, locate/inspect and re-place if needed.
- "on" is not enough: the mouse must sit at the mat centre. If placed_offset shows it off-centre, re-place it toward the mat centre before done.
goal: Mouse rests visibly at the centre of the named colored mat, released by instructed arm (or either if none), flat and not elevated.
